svg.title: Game-tree planning inside the Orchestrator
svg.desc: Decision tree showing how the orchestrator takes an observed signal, classifies it to a MITRE tactic, generates candidate next-moves as branches, scores each, and surfaces the top ranked predictions to the analyst.

sendPrompt('How does the game-tree generator create attacker next moves?')
